body_text:
The modulus is multiplicative and satisfies the triangle
inequality: $|zw|=|z||w|$ and $|z+w|\leq|z|+|w|$. Hence
$d(z,w)=|z-w|$ is a metric inducing the usual Euclidean topology
on the complex plane.
